verdict.rationale: Solid's official README documents a one-command starter: `npx degit solidjs/templates/js my-app`, plus a TypeScript variant. It creates a minimal, client-rendered app powered by Vite, which directly delivers scaffolding from an official starter. missing for 10: documented run/dev-server commands after scaffolding, a dedicated interactive CLI or richer starter options (e.g. SSR/SolidStart templates), and independent hands-on corroboration of the few-minutes setup.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and run a new project in just a few minutes using an official CLI or starter

citations.quote: Or for TypeScript: npx degit solidjs/templates/ts my-app
This will create a minimal, client-rendered application powered by Vite.
